name: Illinois Aviation Academy
summary: West Chicago school that runs a Part 141 career program and prices its private pilot course to the cent.
differentiator: Adds its plane ($206.45) and instructor ($76.18) rates into a $282.63 dual hour, and shows two private pilot totals ($19,346.59 and $15,763.89) built from different hour mixes, which makes the cost of simulator time visible.
pricing: Plane $206.45 an hour plus instructor $76.18, a stated $282.63 dual hour.

estimate.hoursBasis: 35 flight hours with instructor, 5 solo hours, 3 simulator hours and 37 hours of ground school, plus stage checks, medical, written exam, examiner fee and books
estimate.note: A second block on the page shows $15,763.89 for 21 hours with instructor and 12 simulator hours.

feesNamed: Examiner fee $840 plus in-house aircraft time
bestFor: Students who want a Part 141 program priced down to the cent.
skipIf: You want a single hourly rate and no stage-check charges.
watchOut: Two different totals appear on one page; check which hour mix you are buying.
Stage-check hours cost more ($99.23 ground, $305.68 flight) than ordinary instruction.
The page does not say whether the plane rate includes fuel.
